raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly treated Julia’s earlier betrothal to Quintus Servilius Caepio as a “binding union” sufficient to count him as Cornelia’s child-in-law. In Roman practice, a betrothal (sponsalia) was not a marriage and would not make Caepio a son-in-law. This misinterpretation risks leading to the wrong identification. The correct child-in-law is Pompey, Julia’s actual husband.
